verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents creating cards via the Core API from card products, and card products can represent physical cards. That is a thin first-party signal that physical cards are issued through the API without the customer running its own fulfillment. Nothing in the pack covers personalization, card art, bulk ordering, shipping options, or tracking. Missing for 10: custom card art/personalization docs, bulk order endpoints, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, managed card-manufacturer/fulfillment documentation, independent corroboration.
